name: Bramwell Thornbury
description: A portly man in his fifties with a magnificent grey mustache and perpetually flour-dusted apron. His left eye has a noticeable twitch when he's nervous.
personality: Jovial and welcoming to paying customers, but shrewd in business dealings. Has a weakness for gossip and a genuine concern for the welfare of Prigwort's residents.
motivation: Wants to expand his inn and become the most respected businessman in town.
secrets: Knows the location of a smuggler's cache in the cellar
His wife is actually a reformed bandit
